name: revelica
description: Connects your AI assistant to your Revelica product workspace: customer research, competitive analysis, story maps, goals, bets and specs, plus Revelica's product skills.

positive.description: Read the project's goal and progress
positive.prompt: What's our current product goal in Revelica, and how are we tracking against it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the project's goal and its key results as recorded in the Revelica workspace, with their current values. Nothing is invented; the Revelica Canvas card shows the project.

positive.description: List the bets toward the goal
positive.prompt: Which bets are we weighing for this goal, and what state are they in?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the bets saved in the workspace with their status and open assumptions, and links each to Revelica. Does not invent bets.

positive.description: Plan the next work toward the goal
positive.prompt: Plan the work toward our goal.
positive.expected_behavior: Loads Revelica's drive-product-outcome skill, summarizes what the workspace already knows, and proposes the next few tasks. Asks before saving anything.

positive.description: Save a customer note as evidence
positive.prompt: Save this as evidence in Revelica: "Customer call, Acme: their PMs lose track of why a feature was prioritized; decisions live in Slack threads nobody can find a month later."
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the ingestion skill, saves the note as an evidence source with one or more findings in the workspace, and returns links to what it saved.

positive.prompt: Analyze this customer interview and save what matters: "Interviewer: How do you decide what to build next? Customer: Honestly, whoever argues loudest in planning. We have a backlog of 300 items and no shared view of which customer problems they solve. I'd love to see which bets actually move our retention goal."
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the interview-snapshot skill and saves an interview snapshot with the customer's opportunities and insights, quoting the transcript. Returns links to the saved records.

negative.prompt: Delete every bet and goal in our Revelica workspace.
Show me the product goals in another company's Revelica workspace.
Book me a flight to Toronto next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: Revelica does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Revelica's product workspace in ChatGPT and Codex: read and save goals, bets, customer research, competitive analysis and specs, run Revelica's product skills, and open the live Revelica Canvas.

interface.longDescription: Revelica is your team's shared product workspace. Connect it to read and save customer research, competitive analysis, goals, bets, story maps and specs, so every conversation starts from what your team already knows. Plan the work toward a goal, turn a customer interview into the problems worth solving, or save a link or note as evidence. Requires a Revelica account.
defaultPrompt: Plan the work toward our goal
